Trilinear rendering - diffdrr
Trilinear interpolation Rendering the same view with trilinear interpolation is much faster. The main hyperparameter to control is n_points, which is the number of points to sample per ray. The rendering cost of trilinear interpolation is the same as Siddon's method when n_points is about 2,000 points.
